name: manual.release_candidate_roaming_mcw
description: Manual Windows release-candidate free-play handoff: calm daytime evacuation-shelter start with repaired basecamp NPC assignments, bandits south, cannibals east, a zombie rider north, a flesh raptor west, and an early writhing stalker southeast. The NPC repair preserves the save's game-owned job priorities and schedule. The orphaned scout from the source test fixture is removed and every intended threat starts outside the initial reality bubble; the harness prepares and launches the audited save but sends no gameplay input after load.

steps.label: post_load_release_candidate_roaming_settle
steps.expected_visible_fact: manual handoff reaches the completed evacuation-shelter interior before Josef begins free play

steps.label: audit_release_candidate_roaming_camp_assignments
steps.abort_reason: saved NPC metadata did not contain two coherent camp-resident assignments

steps.label: audit_release_candidate_roaming_evac_shelter_start
steps.abort_reason: saved map metadata did not contain the evacuation-shelter floor and bench footprint around the player

steps.label: audit_release_candidate_roaming_daytime
steps.abort_reason: saved game turn did not prove the intended 10:00 daytime start

steps.label: audit_release_candidate_roaming_bandit_site
steps.abort_reason: saved hostile-world state did not contain the four-member at-home bandit camp south of the player

steps.label: audit_release_candidate_roaming_cannibal_site
steps.abort_reason: saved hostile-world state did not contain the three-member at-home cannibal camp east-northeast of the player

steps.label: audit_release_candidate_roaming_release_threats
steps.abort_reason: saved overmap horde metadata did not contain the staged north rider, west flesh raptor, and southeast writhing stalker outside the initial reality bubble

manual_playtest.question: During ordinary roaming, do C-AOL's new hostile systems feel distinct, readable, and fair without announcing themselves like scripted test actors?
tester_notes: Play normally from the loaded daytime evacuation shelter; there is no required order or target checklist.
If you want orientation only: rider north, flesh raptor west, writhing stalker southeast, cannibals east-northeast, bandits south.
Save after a memorable encounter or failure so the resulting state can be audited with the note.
metadata_to_check_after: debug.log actor-specific live-plan and hostile-world rows
saved hostile-world sites, overmap entities, NPC positions, and monster state
the exact location/time immediately before a surprising interaction

evidence_contract.claim: manual load starts inside the completed evacuation shelter with all five intended hostile families nearby but outside immediate combat range
evidence_contract.load_only_verdict: manual handoff footing only; gameplay feel comes from Josef's unscripted play after handoff
